provenance.limit: the two copies at opacity 0 in the draw window get no stroke animation (Lean drawOne_visSame, drawOne_still_iff); saves 2 of 3 animated paths per draw frame (animatedCount_values), the visible copy still lays out per frame

look change: the draw is a clip-path wipe of the visible copy instead of a stroke trace: look-change, for the user's visual review; no layout in the draw-out frames (arm_drawOut_nolayout); the draw-in keeps the original's width transition, which lays out (arm_drawIn_layout_only_width)
